1 · Intro

When to use it.

Most position approval errors come from using inaccurate or outdated positions and a few easy-to-miss fields. These habits keep positions active, clean, and correct, so Oracle shows what positions exist and their status.

Use this whenYou manage positions for your business unit and want to avoid send-backs.

HCM Academy job aid · Position Management

Position management best practices

Use when: You manage positions for your business unit and want to avoid send-backs. · System: Overview

  1. Inactivate and reactivate on purpose.
    • Don't repurpose a vacant position built for another worker type. Create a new one.
  2. Use the job code from the memo.
  3. Request new positions through VU Compensation.
  4. Standard working hours are always 40.
  5. Leave Manager blank on the position.
  6. Set the real location.
  7. Fix the position before the requisition.
  8. Keep documents on the position.

Watch-outs

  • When in doubt about a code, category, or location, ask Compensation or your engagement consultant before you submit.
